evidence: Implements BIP 54 validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp, governing sigop limits, 64-byte transaction bans, coinbase timelocks, and block timestamp constraints.
rationale: This PR implements consensus cleanup rules resolving long-standing consensus vulnerabilities including CVE-2017-12842 and quadratic sigops CPU exhaustion. Because it is configured to be active only on regtest and never active on mainnet, delay is not as immediately critical as an active network fix (P1), but establishing the implementation and regression harness upstream is of high strategic importance for evaluating the soft fork.
